impact: Defensive positioning into Nvidia's beat sets up a possible relief bounce Wednesday in MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS, but the S&P at a four-month low shows how fragile risk appetite is with Fed minutes due Wednesday.
summary: US stocks closed lower Tuesday ahead of Nvidia's results: the Dow fell 848.75 points (1.6%) to 50,759.42, the S&P 500 fell about 1% to 7,340.53, its lowest close since late July, and the Nasdaq slid 0.7% to 24,328.38. Chip stocks were sold before the report, and a CNN report of an outage on an NSA classified network pushed the averages to their lows. Nvidia closed down 0.4%. 24/7 Wall St. said the Nasdaq 100 is headed for its worst November since 2008.
title: Dow drops 849 points, S&P 500 at lowest close since July before Nvidia
